newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to lift capital flow curbs by end 97.
newsitem.headline: Greece to lift capital flow curbs by end 97.

text.p: Greece will lift its remaining few restrictions on capital movements by the end of 1997, Bank of Greece deputy governor Panagiotis Thomopoulos told a conference on the modernisation of the country's banking system.
Thomopoulos said among those changes taking place before the end of 1997 would be allowing residents to open accounts in foreign currency at local banks.

The conference at the Intercontinental Hotel was sponsored by the Hellenic-American Chamber of Commerce and the Union of Hellenic Banks --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Intercontinental Hotel Newsroom +301 902.3666, ext. 6680
